available, use the provided specification as the primary source of expected behavior, and use relevant
production code and repository configuration to fill in missing context.

choose a deterministic, practical level of isolation appropriate for each behavior under test.

## Dependency and Test Boundaries

- Use real, deterministic repository code and direct internal collaborators when practical. Do not mock
  the target or mock every internal collaborator by default.
- Control external, nondeterministic, unavailable, unsafe, or expensive boundaries with existing
  abstractions or lightweight substitutes such as in-memory implementations and temporary directories.
- When replacing a collaborator, assert only behavior or interactions in the target's observable
  contract, not incidental implementation details.
- Do not require credentials, internet access, pre-existing services, or persistent external changes.

## Repository Boundaries

- READ: The target, minimum relevant production context, direct collaborators, and test configuration.
- DO NOT READ existing test source files; infer behavior from the supplied target and production context.
- CREATE/MODIFY: The exact required test file, or for a module target, files under the exact required

- Keep tests deterministic and independent; restore or isolate modified files, environment variables,

- Match the project layout and prefer distinct behavioral cases over redundant coverage.

1. Inspect the minimum production code and configuration needed to understand the target.
2. Design focused behavioral cases and decide which external boundaries require control.
3. Create the required test output and only essential test-related configuration changes.

    @Test
    void aServerInstanceCanBeRestartedAfterItWasStopped() throws Exception {
        Undertow server = track(Undertow.builder()
                .addHttpListener(0, HOST)
                .setHandler(textHandler("restartable"))

        XnioWorker firstWorker = server.getWorker();

        server.stop();
        assertNull(server.getWorker());
        assertTrue(firstWorker.isShutdown());

        server.start();
        XnioWorker secondWorker = server.getWorker();
        assertNotNull(secondWorker);
        assertNotSame(firstWorker, secondWorker, "a fresh internal worker is created on every start");

    @Test
    void workerIoThreadsCanBeConfiguredThroughTheBuilder() {
        XnioWorker configured;
        try {
            Undertow first = track(Undertow.builder()
                    .setIoThreads(2)
                    .setWorkerThreads(2)
                    .addHttpListener(0, HOST)
                    .setHandler(textHandler("threads"))
                    .build());
            first.start();
            configured = first.getWorker();
            assertEquals(2, configured.getIoThreadCount());
            first.stop();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new AssertionError(e);
        }

        Undertow overridden = track(Undertow.builder()
                .setIoThreads(4)
                .setWorkerThreads(4)
                .setWorkerOption(Options.WORKER_IO_THREADS, Integer.valueOf(1))
                .addHttpListener(0, HOST)
                .setHandler(textHandler("threads"))
                .build());
        overridden.start();
        try {
            assertNotNull(overridden.getWorker());
            assertEquals(1, overridden.getWorker().getIoThreadCount(),
                    "explicit worker options must win over setIoThreads()");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new AssertionError(e);
        }
    }

    void deprecatedBuilderMethodsStillCreateAnHttpListener() throws Exception {
        Undertow.Builder builder = Undertow.builder();
        assertSame(builder, builder.setBuffersPerRegion(10));
        assertSame(builder, builder.addListener(0, HOST));

        Undertow server = track(builder.setHandler(textHandler("deprecated")).build());
        server.start();

        Undertow.ListenerInfo info = server.getListenerInfo().get(0);
        assertEquals("http", info.getProtcol());
        assertEquals("deprecated", get(portOf(info), "/").body);
    }

    @Test
    void suppliedByteBufferPoolIsUsedByTheListeners() throws Exception {
        CountingByteBufferPool pool = new CountingByteBufferPool(new DefaultByteBufferPool(false, 1024, 10, 2));
        try {
            Undertow server = track(Undertow.builder()
                    .setByteBufferPool(pool)
                    .addHttpListener(0, HOST)
                    .setHandler(textHandler("pooled"))
                    .build());

            server.start();

            assertEquals(1024, pool.getBufferSize());
            assertFalse(pool.isDirect());

            HttpResponse response = get(portOf(server.getListenerInfo().get(0)), "/pooled");
            assertEquals(200, response.status);
            assertEquals("pooled", response.body);
            assertTrue(pool.allocations.get() > 0, "the supplied pool must be used to allocate buffers");
        } finally {
            pool.close();
        }
    }

        Undertow server = track(Undertow.builder()
                .addHttpListener(0, HOST)
                .setBufferSize(256)
                .setDirectBuffers(false)
                .setHandler(exchange -> exchange.getRequestReceiver()
                        .receiveFullString((ex, message) -> respond(ex, "length=" + message.length())))
                .build());

        server.start();

        StringBuilder body = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 4096; i++) {
            body.append((char) ('a' + (i % 26)));
        }

        HttpResponse response = post(portOf(server.getListenerInfo().get(0)), "/echo", body.toString());
        assertEquals(200, response.status);
        assertEquals("length=4096", response.body);
    }

        Undertow.ListenerInfo plainInfo = plainServer.getListenerInfo().get(0);
        plainInfo.setSslContext(replacement);
        assertNull(plainInfo.getSslContext());
        assertEquals(200, get(portOf(plainInfo), "/").status);
    }

I've completed the test suite. Summary of what was done:

**Created** `core/src/test/java/io/undertow/UndertowTests.java` (JUnit 5, 23 tests) covering `Undertow`'s observable behavior:

- **Builder/lifecycle**: independent builder & server instances, `getListenerInfo()` throwing `IllegalStateException("Server not started")` before start/after stop, `stop()` before start and repeated `stop()`, restarting a stopped instance, worker-thread configuration (`setIoThreads` vs `setWorkerOption` precedence).
- **HTTP listeners**: end-to-end requests through a raw-socket client, `ListenerInfo` protocol/address/suspended/ssl/statistics accessors, unmodifiable listener list, `setSocketOption` delegation, per-listener root handler overriding the server handler, deprecated builder methods.
- **Connector statistics**: disabled by default, enabled through `ListenerInfo.setServerOptions(...)`, request/byte counters verified after traffic.
- **Buffers**: supplied `ByteBufferPool` is actually used (counting wrapper), small non-direct buffers serve a 4 KB POST body.
- **TLS/AJP**: HTTPS with a supplied `SSLContext` (including `setSslContext` update + no-op on plain HTTP), HTTPS built from key/trust managers, HTTPS with HTTP/2+ALPN enabled falling back to HTTP/1.1, AJP listener exposure and accept loop.
- **Proxy protocol**: connections without the `PROXY` preamble are closed without a response, with the preamble the request is served.
- **suspend/resume**: state flag, idle connection closed by `suspend()`, service restored by `resume()`.
- **stop/worker**: internal worker shut down (with `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT`), listeners closed (connection refused after stop), idempotency, externally supplied worker reused and *not* shut down by `stop()`, failed bind shutting down the internal worker with the `BindException` in the cause chain.
- **HTTP/2 upgrade**: offered via `UndertowOptions.ENABLE_HTTP2` and via listener `setHttp2Enabled(true)` (asserting `101 Switching Protocols`/`Upgrade: h2c`), not offered by default.

**Test-runner config** (minimal, essential): added `org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter` (test scope) to `core/pom.xml` and overrode the inherited JUnit-4 category `groups` expression for this module (it is unparseable as a JUnit 5 tag expression; its default value was a tautology, so behavior is unchanged).

All 23 tests pass deterministically (verified across repeated runs); no production code was modified.

/**

class HttpClientExchange extends AbstractAttachable implements ClientExchange {

    private static final Logger log = Logger.getLogger(HttpClientExchange.class.getName());

    private final ClientRequest request;
    private final boolean requiresContinue;
    private final HttpClientConnection clientConnection;

    private ClientCallback<ClientExchange> responseCallback;
    private ClientCallback<ClientExchange> readyCallback;
    private ContinueNotification continueNotification;

    private ClientResponse response;
    private ClientResponse continueResponse;
    private IOException failedReason;
    private HttpRequestConduit requestConduit;

    private int state = 0;
    private static final int REQUEST_TERMINATED = 1;
    private static final int RESPONSE_TERMINATED = 1 << 1;

    HttpClientExchange(ClientCallback<ClientExchange> readyCallback, ClientRequest request, HttpClientConnection clientConnection) {
        this.readyCallback = readyCallback;
        this.request = request;
        this.clientConnection = clientConnection;
        boolean reqContinue = false;
        if (request.getRequestHeaders().contains(Headers.EXPECT)) {
            for (String header : request.getRequestHeaders().get(Headers.EXPECT)) {
                if (header.equals("100-continue")) {
                    reqContinue = true;
                }
            }
        }
        this.requiresContinue = reqContinue;
    }

    public void setRequestConduit(HttpRequestConduit requestConduit) {
        this.requestConduit = requestConduit;
    }

    void terminateRequest() {
        if(anyAreSet(state, REQUEST_TERMINATED)) {
            return;
        }
        log.debugf("request terminated for request to %s %s", clientConnection.getPeerAddress(), getRequest().getPath());
        state |= REQUEST_TERMINATED;
        clientConnection.requestDataSent();
        if (anyAreSet(state, RESPONSE_TERMINATED)) {
            clientConnection.exchangeDone();
        }
    }

    boolean isRequestDataSent() {
        return anyAreSet(state, REQUEST_TERMINATED);
    }

    void terminateResponse() {
        if(anyAreSet(state, RESPONSE_TERMINATED)) {
            return;
        }
        log.debugf("response terminated for request to %s %s", clientConnection.getPeerAddress(), getRequest().getPath());
        state |= RESPONSE_TERMINATED;
        if (anyAreSet(state, REQUEST_TERMINATED)) {
            clientConnection.exchangeDone();
        }
    }

    public boolean isRequiresContinue() {
        return requiresContinue;
    }


    void setContinueResponse(ClientResponse response) {
        this.continueResponse = response;
        if (continueNotification != null) {
            this.continueNotification.handleContinue(this);
        }
    }

    void setResponse(ClientResponse response) {
        this.response = response;
        if (responseCallback != null) {
            this.responseCallback.completed(this);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setResponseListener(ClientCallback<ClientExchange> listener) {
        this.responseCallback = listener;
        if (listener != null) {
            if (failedReason != null) {
                listener.failed(failedReason);
            } else if (response != null) {
                listener.completed(this);
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean flush() throws IOException {

        log.trace("flush");
        int oldVal;
        do {
            oldVal = state;
            if (anyAreSet(oldVal, FLAG_WRITING)) {
                return false;
            }
        } while (!stateUpdater.compareAndSet(this, oldVal, oldVal | FLAG_WRITING));
        int state = oldVal & MASK_STATE;
        try {
            if (state != 0) {
                state = processWrite(state, null);
                if (state != 0) {
                    log.trace("Flush false because headers aren't written yet");
                    return false;
                }
                if (allAreSet(oldVal, FLAG_SHUTDOWN)) {
                    next.terminateWrites();
                    // fall out to the flush
                }
            }
            log.trace("Delegating flush");
            return next.flush();
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error e) {
            this.state |= FLAG_SHUTDOWN;
            if(pooledBuffer != null) {
                pooledBuffer.close();
                pooledBuffer = null;
            }
            throw e;
        } finally {
            this.state = oldVal & ~MASK_STATE | state;
        }
    }


    public void terminateWrites() throws IOException {
        log.trace("shutdown");
        int oldVal = this.state;
        if (allAreClear(oldVal, MASK_STATE)) {
            next.terminateWrites();
            return;
        }
        this.state = oldVal | FLAG_SHUTDOWN;
    }

    public void truncateWrites() throws IOException {
        log.trace("close");
        int oldVal = this.state;
        if (allAreClear(oldVal, MASK_STATE)) {
            try {
                next.truncateWrites();
            } finally {
                if (pooledBuffer != null) {
                    pooledBuffer.close();
                    pooledBuffer = null;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        this.state = oldVal & ~MASK_STATE | FLAG_SHUTDOWN;
        throw new TruncatedResponseException();
    }

    public XnioWorker getWorker() {
        return next.getWorker();
    }

    public void freeBuffers() {
        if(pooledBuffer != null) {
            pooledBuffer.close();
            pooledBuffer = null;
            this.state = state & ~MASK_STATE | FLAG_SHUTDOWN;
        }
    }

    private static ByteBuffer[] buildDataArray(ByteBuffer[] userData, ByteBuffer buffer) {
        int userDataLen = userData.length;
        ByteBuffer[] data = new ByteBuffer[userDataLen + 1];
        data[0] = buffer;
        System.arraycopy(userData, 0, data, 1, userDataLen);
        return data;
    }

    private boolean writeBufferArray(ByteBuffer[] data) throws IOException {
        long totalWritten = 0;
        long totalRemaining = 0;

        for (ByteBuffer buffer : data) {
            totalRemaining += buffer.remaining();
        }

        do {
            long r = next.write(data, 0, data.length);
            totalWritten += r;
            if ((r == 0) && (totalWritten < totalRemaining)) {
                log.trace("Continuation");
                return false;
            }
        } while (totalWritten < totalRemaining);

        // ? The original code allowed for an early return under certain conditions. If that condition is met, retunr
        // false from the loop. Otherwise, return true here to indicate a successful completion. Can't return bytes
        // written since it might get confused for STATE_BUF_FLUSH
        return true;
    }

        HttpClientConnection connection = newConnection();
        CloseRecorder closeRecorder = new CloseRecorder();
        connection.addCloseListener(closeRecorder);
        ClientRequest request = request(Methods.GET, "/last");

messages.reasoning_content:
Many issues. Let's diagnose. First: sendRequest no content apparently fails? `sendRequestWritesRequestHead...` assertion line 206 expected true but false — probably written doesn't start with expected; maybe head not written or flush returned false... And `sendRequestDoesNotAddUpgradeHeaders...` second send gets ClosedChannelException → means connection got closed during first sendRequest, likely handleError due to exception while flushing (e.g., PooledByteBuffer leak? no). Let's look at surefire report stdout for one test / run a single test with -Dtest=...#method and full output. Also examine line numbers.

First hypothesis: `ConduitStreamSinkChannel.flush()` calls conduit.flush then `if (flushed) ...`? Fine. Maybe HttpRequestConduit's pooled buffer gets from DefaultByteBufferPool; `HttpRequestConduit` writes headers; but our TestSinkConduit write gets ByteBuffer possibly with position/limit; records.

Why connection closed after first send with empty content? Maybe `sinkChannel.shutdownWrites()` triggers ClientFixedLength terminateWrites: state contentLength 0; enterShutdown → since remaining==0, no close flags; then `anyAreSet(val, MASK_COUNT)` false → `else if allAreSet(config, PASS_CLOSE)` false → nothing. Then flush works. Then resumeWrites? no.

Could be an exception from `HttpRequestConduit` or sink. `initiateRequest` catch(Throwable t) → handleError; handleError does currentRequest.setFailed then currentRequest=null; safeClose(connection). Then sendRequest returns; callback.failure non-null? The test asserted `assertNull(callback.failure)` at line ~200 before 206; failure was null? The assertion failing at 206 expected true but false, so callback wasn't failed. Hmm.

Maybe the request head written but format has lowercase? Let's print actual written. Add debug via running a tiny test? Easier: surefire report contains stdout? Our assertions include message `written` in assertTrue(written.startsWith... , written) so failure message shows actual string. Let's grep report.

    @Test
    void sendRequestAddsHttp2UpgradeHeadersWhenHttp2IsEnabled() {
        HttpClientConnection connection = newConnection(OptionMap.create(UndertowOptions.ENABLE_HTTP2, true));
        ClientRequest request = request(Methods.GET, "/h2c");

        RecordingCallback callback = send(connection, request);

        assertNull(callback.failure);
        assertEquals("h2c", request.getRequestHeaders().getFirst(Headers.UPGRADE));
        assertEquals("Upgrade, HTTP2-Settings", request.getRequestHeaders().getFirst(Headers.CONNECTION));
        assertNotNull(request.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("HTTP2-Settings"));
        String written = transport(connection).sinkText();
        assertTrue(written.contains("Upgrade: h2c\r\n"), written);
        assertTrue(written.contains("HTTP2-Settings: "), written);
        // the upgrade header puts the connection into the upgrade-requested state
        assertTrue(connection.isUpgraded());

        RecordingCallback second = send(connection, request(Methods.GET, "/second"));
        assertEquals(1, second.failed);
        assertEquals(UndertowClientMessages.MESSAGES.invalidConnectionState().getMessage(), second.failure.getMessage());
        assertEquals(1, countOccurrences(transport(connection).sinkText(), "GET /"), "queued request must not be written");
    }

    @Test
    void sendRequestDoesNotAddUpgradeHeadersWhenHttp2IsDisabled() {
        HttpClientConnection connection = newConnection();
        ClientRequest request = request(Methods.GET, "/plain");

        RecordingCallback callback = send(connection, request);

        assertNull(callback.failure);
        assertFalse(request.getRequestHeaders().contains(Headers.UPGRADE));
        assertFalse(request.getRequestHeaders().contains("HTTP2-Settings"));
        assertFalse(connection.isUpgraded());

        RecordingCallback second = send(connection, request(Methods.GET, "/queued"));
        assertNull(second.failure);
        assertEquals(0, second.completed, "second request is queued while the first exchange is open");
        assertEquals(1, countOccurrences(transport(connection).sinkText(), "GET /"));
    }

package io.undertow.protocols.http2;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import io.undertow.util.HeaderMap;
import io.undertow.util.Headers;
import io.undertow.util.HttpString;

/**
 * Behavioural tests for the HPACK encoder. The assertions use the HPACK wire
 * format and the companion decoder to verify the encoder's externally visible
 * contract.
 */
@Tag("io.undertow.testutils.category.UnitTest")
class HpackEncoderTests {

    private static final HttpString X_TEST = new HttpString("x-test");
    private static final HttpString X_ALPHA = new HttpString("x-alpha");
    private static final HttpString X_BETA = new HttpString("x-beta");

    private static final HpackEncoder.HpackHeaderFunction NO_INDEXING_OR_HUFFMAN = new HpackEncoder.HpackHeaderFunction() {
        @Override
        public boolean shouldUseIndexing(HttpString header, String value) {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean shouldUseHuffman(HttpString header, String value) {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean shouldUseHuffman(HttpString header) {
            return false;
        }
    };

    private static final HpackEncoder.HpackHeaderFunction ALWAYS_HUFFMAN = new HpackEncoder.HpackHeaderFunction() {
        @Override
        public boolean shouldUseIndexing(HttpString header, String value) {
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean shouldUseHuffman(HttpString header, String value) {
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean shouldUseHuffman(HttpString header) {
            return true;
        }
    };

    @Test
    void encodesExactStaticTableMatchesAsASingleIndexedOctet() {
        assertArrayEquals(octets(0x82), encodeFully(new HpackEncoder(4096), headers(":method", "GET")));
        assertArrayEquals(octets(0x84), encodeFully(new HpackEncoder(4096), headers(":path", "/")));
        assertArrayEquals(octets(0x87), encodeFully(new HpackEncoder(4096), headers(":scheme", "https")));
        assertArrayEquals(octets(0x88), encodeFully(new HpackEncoder(4096), headers(":status", "200")));
        assertArrayEquals(octets(0x8d), encodeFully(new HpackEncoder(4096), headers(":status", "404")));
        assertArrayEquals(octets(0x90), encodeFully(new HpackEncoder(4096), headers("accept-encoding", "gzip, deflate")));
    }

    @Test
    void encodesUnknownHeaderAsLiteralWithIncrementalIndexing() {
        byte[] encoded = encodeFully(new HpackEncoder(4096), headers("x-test", "abc"));

        assertArrayEquals(new byte[]{
                0x40, 0x06, 'x', '-', 't', 'e', 's', 't', 0x03, 'a', 'b', 'c'
        }, encoded);
    }

    @Test
    void usesStaticHeaderNameWithLiteralValue() {
        byte[] encoded = encodeFully(new HpackEncoder(4096), headers(":authority", "abc"));

        // 0x40 (literal with incremental indexing) + static index 1, then a
        // non-Huffman value because its length is below the default threshold.
        assertArrayEquals(new byte[]{0x41, 0x03, 'a', 'b', 'c'}, encoded);
    }

    @Test
    void indexesDynamicEntriesAndUsesTheirIndexOnTheNextEncoding() {
        HpackEncoder encoder = new HpackEncoder(4096);
        HeaderMap headers = headers("x-test", "abc");

        byte[] first = encodeFully(encoder, headers);
        assertEquals(0x40, first[0] & 0xff);

        // The first entry in the dynamic table has HPACK index 62.
        assertArrayEquals(octets(0xbe), encodeFully(encoder, headers));
    }

    @Test
    void preservesTheOrderOfMultipleValuesWhenUsingDynamicIndices() {
        HpackEncoder encoder = new HpackEncoder(4096);
        HeaderMap headers = headers("x-test", "abc", "def");

        encodeFully(encoder, headers);

        // The latest entry is index 62 and the first one is index 63.
        assertArrayEquals(new byte[]{(byte) 0xbf, (byte) 0xbe}, encodeFully(encoder, headers));
    }

    @Test
        }
        return headers;
    }

    private static byte[] encodeFully(HpackEncoder encoder, HeaderMap headers) {
        ByteBuffer target = ByteBuffer.allocate(8192);
        assertEquals(HpackEncoder.State.COMPLETE, encoder.encode(headers, target));
        return bytes(target);
    }

    private static byte[] bytes(ByteBuffer target) {
        target.flip();
        byte[] result = new byte[target.remaining()];
        target.get(result);
        return result;
    }

    private static byte[] octets(int... values) {
        byte[] result = new byte[values.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < values.length; ++i) {
            result[i] = (byte) values[i];
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static List<DecodedHeader> decode(byte[] encoded) throws HpackException {
        HpackDecoder decoder = new HpackDecoder();
        DecodingEmitter emitter = new DecodingEmitter();
        decoder.setHeaderEmitter(emitter);
        decoder.decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(encoded), false);
        return emitter.headers;
    }

    private static WireString readString(ByteBuffer encoded) throws HpackException {
        assertTrue(encoded.hasRemaining());
        boolean huffman = (encoded.get(encoded.position()) & 0x80) != 0;
        int length = Hpack.decodeInteger(encoded, 7);
        assertTrue(length >= 0);
        byte[] content = new byte[length];
        encoded.get(content);
        return new WireString(huffman, content);
    }

    private static final class WireString {
        private final boolean huffman;
        private final byte[] content;

        private WireString(boolean huffman, byte[] content) {
            this.huffman = huffman;
            this.content = content;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return new String(content, StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1);
        }
    }

    private static final class DecodedHeader {
        private final HttpString name;
        private final String value;
        private final boolean neverIndex;

        private DecodedHeader(HttpString name, String value, boolean neverIndex) {
            this.name = name;
            this.value = value;
            this.neverIndex = neverIndex;
        }
    }

    private static final class DecodingEmitter implements HpackDecoder.HeaderEmitter {
        private final List<DecodedHeader> headers = new ArrayList<>();

        @Override
        public void emitHeader(HttpString name, String value, boolean neverIndex) {
            assertNotNull(name);
            headers.add(new DecodedHeader(name, value, neverIndex));
        }
    }
}

    private synchronized void updateStreamIdsCountersInHeaders(int streamNo) {

    int grabFlowControlBytes(int bytesToGrab) {
        if(bytesToGrab <= 0) {

        int min;
        synchronized (flowControlLock) {
            min = (int) Math.min(bytesToGrab, sendWindowSize);

package io.undertow.protocols.http2;

import java.nio.ByteBuffer;

import io.undertow.server.protocol.framed.SendFrameHeader;
import io.undertow.util.ImmediatePooledByteBuffer;

/**
 * A window update frame.
 *
 * @author Stuart Douglas
 */
class Http2WindowUpdateStreamSinkChannel extends Http2NoDataStreamSinkChannel {

    //length (4) and frame type. There are never any flags
    public static final int HEADER_FIRST_LINE = (4 << 8) | (Http2Channel.FRAME_TYPE_WINDOW_UPDATE);
    private final int streamId;
    private final int deltaWindowSize;

    protected Http2WindowUpdateStreamSinkChannel(Http2Channel channel, int streamId, int deltaWindowSize) {
        super(channel);
        this.streamId = streamId;
        this.deltaWindowSize = deltaWindowSize;
    }

    @Override
    protected SendFrameHeader createFrameHeader() {
        ByteBuffer buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(13);
        Http2ProtocolUtils.putInt(buf, HEADER_FIRST_LINE);
        buf.put((byte)0);
        Http2ProtocolUtils.putInt(buf, streamId);
        Http2ProtocolUtils.putInt(buf, deltaWindowSize);
        buf.flip();
        return new SendFrameHeader(new ImmediatePooledByteBuffer(buf));
    }

}

class Http2ProtocolUtils {

    public static void putInt(final ByteBuffer buffer, int value) {
        buffer.put((byte) (value >> 24));
        buffer.put((byte) (value >> 16));
        buffer.put((byte) (value >> 8));
        buffer.put((byte) value);
    }

    public static void putInt(final ByteBuffer buffer, int value, int position) {
        buffer.put(position, (byte) (value >> 24));
        buffer.put(position + 1, (byte) (value >> 16));
        buffer.put(position + 2, (byte) (value >> 8));
        buffer.put(position + 3, (byte) value);
    }

    public static int readInt(ByteBuffer buffer) {
        int id = (buffer.get() & 0xFF) << 24;
        id += (buffer.get() & 0xFF) << 16;
        id += (buffer.get() & 0xFF) << 8;
        id += (buffer.get() & 0xFF);
        return id;
    }

    private Http2ProtocolUtils() {

        for (Frame frame : frames) {
            if (frame.type() == FRAME_TYPE_HEADERS || frame.type() == FRAME_TYPE_CONTINUATION) {
                length += frame.payload().length;
            }
        }
        ByteBuffer block = ByteBuffer.allocate(length);
        for (Frame frame : frames) {
            if (frame.type() == FRAME_TYPE_HEADERS || frame.type() == FRAME_TYPE_CONTINUATION) {
                block.put(frame.payload());
            }
        }
        block.flip();

        HeaderMap decoded = new HeaderMap();
        HpackDecoder decoder = new HpackDecoder(Hpack.DEFAULT_TABLE_SIZE);
        decoder.setHeaderEmitter((name, value, neverIndex) -> decoded.put(name, value));
        decoder.decode(block, false);
        assertFalse(block.hasRemaining());
        return decoded;
    }

    private static List<Frame> parseFrames(ByteBuffer source) {
        ByteBuffer buffer = source.duplicate();
        List<Frame> frames = new ArrayList<>();
        while (buffer.hasRemaining()) {
            if (buffer.remaining() < 9) {
                throw new AssertionError("Truncated HTTP/2 frame header: " + buffer.remaining() + " bytes");
            }
            int length = ((buffer.get() & 0xFF) << 16) | ((buffer.get() & 0xFF) << 8) | (buffer.get() & 0xFF);
            int type = buffer.get() & 0xFF;
            int flags = buffer.get() & 0xFF;
            int streamId = ((buffer.get() & 0x7F) << 24) | ((buffer.get() & 0xFF) << 16)
                    | ((buffer.get() & 0xFF) << 8) | (buffer.get() & 0xFF);
            boolean externalDataPayload = type == FRAME_TYPE_DATA && buffer.remaining() < length;
            if (buffer.remaining() < length && !externalDataPayload) {
                throw new AssertionError("Truncated HTTP/2 frame payload");
            }
            byte[] payload;
            if (externalDataPayload) {
                // DATA payload is carried outside the frame-header pooled buffer.  For a
                // padded DATA frame, only the pad-length octet is present here.
                int localPayload = (flags & DATA_FLAG_PADDED) != 0 && buffer.hasRemaining() ? 1 : 0;
                payload = new byte[localPayload];
                buffer.get(payload);
            } else {
                payload = new byte[length];
                buffer.get(payload);
            }
            frames.add(new Frame(length, type, flags, streamId, payload));
        }
        return frames;
    }

    private record Frame(int length, int type, int flags, int streamId, byte[] payload) {
    }

 *
 * @author Stuart Douglas

public class ExistsPredicate implements Predicate {

    private final ExchangeAttribute attribute;

    ExistsPredicate(final ExchangeAttribute attribute) {
        this.attribute = attribute;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean resolve(final HttpServerExchange value) {
        final String att = attribute.readAttribute(value);
        if(att == null) {
            return false;
        }
        return !att.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "exists( '" + attribute.toString() + "' )";
    }

    public static class Builder implements PredicateBuilder {

        @Override
        public String name() {
            return "exists";
 */
public class EqualsPredicate implements Predicate {

    private final ExchangeAttribute[] attributes;

    EqualsPredicate(final ExchangeAttribute[] attributes) {
        this.attributes = attributes;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean resolve(final HttpServerExchange value) {
        if(attributes.length < 2) {
            return true;
        }
        String first = attributes[0].readAttribute(value);
        for(int i = 1; i < attributes.length; ++i) {
            String current = attributes[i].readAttribute(value);
            if(first == null) {
                if(current != null) {
                    return false;
                }
            } else if(current == null) {
                return false;
            } else if(!first.equals(current)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "equals( {" +  Arrays.asList( attributes ).stream().map(a->a.toString()).collect(Collectors.joining(", ")) + "} )";
    }

    public static final int STRING_LENGTH_MASK = 1 << 31;

    protected IntegerHolder parse16BitInteger(ByteBuffer buf, AjpRequestParseState state) {
        if (!buf.hasRemaining()) {
            return new IntegerHolder(-1, false);
        }
        int number = state.currentIntegerPart;
        if (number == -1) {
            number = (buf.get() & 0xFF);
        }
        if (buf.hasRemaining()) {
            final byte b = buf.get();
            int result = ((0xFF & number) << 8) + (b & 0xFF);
            state.currentIntegerPart = -1;
            return new IntegerHolder(result, true);
        } else {
            state.currentIntegerPart = number;
            return new IntegerHolder(-1, false);
        }
    }

    protected StringHolder parseString(ByteBuffer buf, AjpRequestParseState state, StringType type) throws UnsupportedEncodingException, BadRequestException {
        boolean containsUrlCharacters = state.containsUrlCharacters;
        boolean containsUnencodedUrlCharacters = state.containsUnencodedUrlCharacters;
        if (!buf.hasRemaining()) {
            return new StringHolder(null, false, false, false);
        }
        int stringLength = state.stringLength;
        if (stringLength == -1) {
            int number = buf.get() & 0xFF;
            if (buf.hasRemaining()) {
                final byte b = buf.get();
                stringLength = ((0xFF & number) << 8) + (b & 0xFF);
            } else {
                state.stringLength = number | STRING_LENGTH_MASK;
                return new StringHolder(null, false, false, false);
            }
        } else if ((stringLength & STRING_LENGTH_MASK) != 0) {
            int number = stringLength & ~STRING_LENGTH_MASK;
            stringLength = ((0xFF & number) << 8) + (buf.get() & 0xFF);
        }
        if (type == StringType.HEADER && (stringLength & 0xFF00) != 0) {
            state.stringLength = -1;
            return new StringHolder(headers(stringLength & 0xFF));
        }
        if (stringLength == 0xFFFF) {
            //OxFFFF means null
            state.stringLength = -1;
            return new StringHolder(null, true, false, false);
        }
        int length = state.getCurrentStringLength();
        while (length < stringLength) {
            if (!buf.hasRemaining()) {
                state.stringLength = stringLength;
                state.containsUrlCharacters = containsUrlCharacters;
                state.containsUnencodedUrlCharacters = containsUnencodedUrlCharacters;
                return new StringHolder(null, false, false, false);
            }
            byte c = buf.get();
            if(type == StringType.QUERY_STRING && (c == '+' || c == '%' || c < 0 || c > 127 )) {
                if (c < 0 || c > 127) {
                    if (!allowUnescapedCharactersInUrl) {
                        throw new BadRequestException();
                    } else {
                        containsUnencodedUrlCharacters = true;
                    }
                }
                containsUrlCharacters = true;
            } else if(type == StringType.URL && (c == '%' || c < 0 || c > 127 )) {
                if(c < 0 ) {
                    if(!allowUnescapedCharactersInUrl) {
                        throw new BadRequestException();
                    } else {
                        containsUnencodedUrlCharacters = true;
                    }
                }
                containsUrlCharacters = true;
            }
            state.addStringByte(c);
            ++length;
        }

        if (buf.hasRemaining()) {
            buf.get(); //null terminator
            String value = state.getStringAndClear();
            state.stringLength = -1;
            state.containsUrlCharacters = false;
            state.containsUnencodedUrlCharacters = containsUnencodedUrlCharacters;
            return new StringHolder(value, true, containsUrlCharacters, containsUnencodedUrlCharacters);
        } else {
            state.stringLength = stringLength;
            state.containsUrlCharacters = containsUrlCharacters;
            state.containsUnencodedUrlCharacters = containsUnencodedUrlCharacters;
            return new StringHolder(null, false, false, false);
        }
    }

            this.value = value;

    @Test
    public void undecodableQueryStringIsFlaggedAsBadRequestWhenUnescapedCharactersAreAllowed() throws Exception {
        final AjpRequestParser parser = new AjpRequestParser("UTF-8", true, MAX_PARAMETERS, MAX_HEADERS, false, true);
        final AjpRequestParseState state = new AjpRequestParseState();
        parser.parse(RequestBuilder.request()
                .attribute(AjpRequestParser.QUERY_STRING, "a=%zz&b=caf00e9")
                .buffer(), state, new HttpServerExchange(null));

        assertTrue(state.isComplete());
        assertTrue(state.badRequest, "an undecodable query string must flag the request as bad");
    }

    @Test
    public void nullQueryStringAttributeIsTreatedAsEmpty() throws Exception {
        final HttpServerExchange exchange = new HttpServerExchange(null);
        newParser().parse(RequestBuilder.request()
                .attribute(AjpRequestParser.QUERY_STRING, null)
                .buffer(), new AjpRequestParseState(), exchange);

        assertEquals("", exchange.getQueryString());
        assertTrue(exchange.getQueryParameters().isEmpty());
    }


    @Test
    public void encodedPathParameterValuesAreDecoded() throws Exception {
        final HttpServerExchange exchange = new HttpServerExchange(null);
        newParser().parse(RequestBuilder.request().uri("/foo;jsessionid=a%20b").buffer(),
                new AjpRequestParseState(), exchange);

        assertEquals("/foo", exchange.getRequestPath());
        assertEquals("a b", exchange.getPathParameters().get("jsessionid").getFirst());
    }


    @Test
    public void tooManyPathParametersAreFlaggedAsBadRequest() throws Exception {
        final AjpRequestParser parser = new AjpRequestParser("UTF-8", true, 1, MAX_HEADERS, false, false);
        final AjpRequestParseState state = new AjpRequestParseState();
        parser.parse(RequestBuilder.request().uri("/foo;a=1;b=2").buffer(), state, new HttpServerExchange(null));

        assertTrue(state.isComplete());
        assertTrue(state.badRequest, "exceeding maxParameters must flag the request as bad");
    }


    @Test
    public void requestWithoutHeadersOrAttributesCompletes() throws Exception {
        final HttpServerExchange exchange = new HttpServerExchange(null);
        final AjpRequestParseState state = new AjpRequestParseState();
        newParser().parse(RequestBuilder.request().uri("/plain").buffer(), state, exchange);

        assertTrue(state.isComplete());
        assertEquals(0, exchange.getRequestHeaders().size());
        assertTrue(exchange.getQueryParameters().isEmpty());
        assertEquals("/plain", exchange.getRequestPath());
    }


    @Test
    public void incompleteHeaderLeavesParserWaitingForMoreData() throws Exception {
        final byte[] data = toBytes(RequestBuilder.request().uri("/wait").codedHeader(0xB, "localhost").buffer());
        // magic number + data size + prefix code + method are enough to move on to the protocol string
        final AjpRequestParseState state = new AjpRequestParseState();
        final HttpServerExchange exchange = new HttpServerExchange(null);

        newParser().parse(ByteBuffer.wrap(data, 0, 2), state, exchange);
        assertEquals(AjpRequestParseState.READING_DATA_SIZE, state.state);
        assertFalse(state.isComplete());

        newParser().parse(ByteBuffer.wrap(data, 2, 2), state, exchange);
        assertEquals(AjpRequestParseState.READING_PREFIX_CODE, state.state);
        assertFalse(state.isComplete());
    }

        final AjpRequestParser parser = newParser();

        assertFalse(holder.readComplete);

import io.undertow.util.Protocols;

 * unless the method under test is itself part of the (protected) class contract.

    @Test
    public void parsesForwardRequestDeliveredInASingleBuffer() throws Exception {
        final ByteBuffer buffer = RequestBuilder.request()
                .method(2)
                .protocol("HTTP/1.1")
                .uri("/test")
                .remoteAddress("10.0.0.1")
                .remoteHost("client.example.com")
                .serverName("server.example.com")
                .serverPort(8080)
                .ssl(false)
                .codedHeader(0xB, "example.com")
                .codedHeader(0x8, "0")
                .header("X-Custom-Header", "custom value")
                .attribute(AjpRequestParser.QUERY_STRING, "a=1&b=2")
                .buffer();
        final int expectedDataSize = buffer.remaining() - 4;

        final AjpRequestParseState state = new AjpRequestParseState();
        final HttpServerExchange exchange = new HttpServerExchange(null);

        newParser().parse(buffer, state, exchange);

        assertTrue(state.isComplete(), "the message terminated by 0xFF must complete the state machine");
        assertEquals(AjpRequestParseState.DONE, state.state);
        assertEquals(expectedDataSize, state.dataSize);
        assertEquals(0, buffer.remaining(), "the whole buffer must be consumed");

        assertEquals(Methods.GET, exchange.getRequestMethod());
        assertEquals(Protocols.HTTP_1_1, exchange.getProtocol());
        assertEquals("http", exchange.getRequestScheme());
        assertEquals("/test", exchange.getRequestURI());
        assertEquals("/test", exchange.getRequestPath());
        assertEquals("/test", exchange.getRelativePath());

        assertEquals("10.0.0.1", state.remoteAddress);
        assertEquals("server.example.com", state.serverAddress);
        assertEquals(8080, state.serverPort);
        assertEquals(-1, state.remotePort);

        assertEquals("example.com", exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst(Headers.HOST));
        assertEquals("0", exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst(Headers.CONTENT_LENGTH));
        assertEquals("custom value", exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst(new HttpString("x-custom-header")));
        assertEquals(3, exchange.getRequestHeaders().size());

        assertEquals("a=1&b=2", exchange.getQueryString());
        assertEquals("1", exchange.getQueryParameters().get("a").getFirst());
        assertEquals("2", exchange.getQueryParameters().get("b").getFirst());
    }

                .serverPort(9090)

        final AjpRequestParseState state = new AjpRequestParseState();
        final HttpServerExchange exchange = new HttpServerExchange(null);

        // after half of the message the parser must still be mid-request
        final int half = data.length / 2;
        parser.parse(ByteBuffer.wrap(data, 0, half), state, exchange);

        for (int i = half; i < data.length; i++) {

        assertEquals(9090, state.serverPort);

    public void exchangeComplete(final HttpServerExchange exchange) {
        connection.clearChannel();
        connection.setCurrentExchange(null);
        final HttpServerConnection connection = this.connection;
        if (exchange.isPersistent() && !isUpgradeOrConnect(exchange)) {

                    channel.getSourceChannel().resumeReads();
                    requestStateUpdater.set(this, 0);
                } else {
                    while (true) {
                        if (connection.getOriginalSourceConduit().isReadShutdown() || connection.getOriginalSinkConduit().isWriteShutdown()) {
                            channel.getSourceChannel().suspendReads();
                            channel.getSinkChannel().suspendWrites();
                            IoUtils.safeClose(connection);
                            return;
                        } else {
                            if (requestStateUpdater.compareAndSet(this, 1, 2)) {

    private void handleHttp2PriorKnowledge(final StreamConnection connection, final HttpServerConnection serverConnection, PooledByteBuffer readData) throws IOException {

        final ConduitStreamSourceChannel request = connection.getSourceChannel();

        byte[] data = new byte[PRI_EXPECTED.length];
        final ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(data);
        if(readData.getBuffer().hasRemaining()) {
            while (readData.getBuffer().hasRemaining() && buffer.hasRemaining()) {
                buffer.put(readData.getBuffer().get());
            }
        }
        final PooledByteBuffer extraData;
        if(readData.getBuffer().hasRemaining()) {
            extraData = readData;
        } else {
            readData.close();
            extraData = null;
        }
        if(!doHttp2PriRead(connection, buffer, serverConnection, extraData)) {
            request.getReadSetter().set(new ChannelListener<StreamSourceChannel>() {
                @Override
                public void handleEvent(StreamSourceChannel channel) {
                    try {
                        doHttp2PriRead(connection, buffer, serverConnection, extraData);
                    } catch (IOException e) {
                        UndertowLogger.REQUEST_IO_LOGGER.ioException(e);
                        IoUtils.safeClose(connection);
                    } catch (Throwable t) {
                        UndertowLogger.REQUEST_IO_LOGGER.handleUnexpectedFailure(t);
                        IoUtils.safeClose(connection);
                    }
                }
            });
            request.resumeReads();
        }
    }

    private boolean doHttp2PriRead(StreamConnection connection, ByteBuffer buffer, HttpServerConnection serverConnection, PooledByteBuffer extraData) throws IOException {
        if(buffer.hasRemaining()) {
            int res = connection.getSourceChannel().read(buffer);
            if (res == -1) {
                return true; //fail
            }
            if (buffer.hasRemaining()) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        buffer.flip();
        for(int i = 0; i < PRI_EXPECTED.length; ++i) {
            if(buffer.get() != PRI_EXPECTED[i]) {
                throw UndertowMessages.MESSAGES.http2PriRequestFailed();
            }

        Http2ReceiveListener receiveListener = new Http2ReceiveListener(serverConnection.getRootHandler(), serverConnection.getUndertowOptions(), serverConnection.getBufferSize(), null);
        channel.getReceiveSetter().set(receiveListener);
        channel.resumeReceives();
        return true;
    }

package io.undertow.util;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.Charset;

import io.undertow.UndertowLogger;
import org.xnio.ChannelListener;
import org.xnio.ChannelListeners;
import org.xnio.IoUtils;
import org.xnio.channels.StreamSinkChannel;

/**
 * A simple write listener that can be used to write out the contents of a String. When the string is written
 * out it closes the channel.
 *
 * This should not be added directly to the channel, instead {@link #setup(org.xnio.channels.StreamSinkChannel)}
 * should be called, which will attempt a write, and only add the listener if required.
 *
 * @author Stuart Douglas
 */
public class StringWriteChannelListener implements ChannelListener<StreamSinkChannel> {

    private final ByteBuffer buffer;

    public StringWriteChannelListener( final String string) {
        this(string, Charset.defaultCharset());
    }

    public StringWriteChannelListener( final String string, Charset charset) {
        buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(string.getBytes(charset));
    }

    public void setup(final StreamSinkChannel channel) {
        try {
            int c;
            do {
                c = channel.write(buffer);
            } while (buffer.hasRemaining() && c > 0);
            if (buffer.hasRemaining()) {
                channel.getWriteSetter().set(this);
                channel.resumeWrites();
            } else {
                writeDone(channel);
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            handleError(channel, e);
        }
    }

    protected void handleError(StreamSinkChannel channel, IOException e) {
        UndertowLogger.REQUEST_IO_LOGGER.ioException(e);
        IoUtils.safeClose(channel);
    }

    @Override
    public void handleEvent(final StreamSinkChannel channel) {
        try {
            int c;
            do {
                c = channel.write(buffer);
            } while (buffer.hasRemaining() && c > 0);
            if (buffer.hasRemaining()) {
                channel.resumeWrites();
                return;
            } else {
                writeDone(channel);
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            handleError(channel, e);
        }
    }

    public boolean hasRemaining() {
        return buffer.hasRemaining();
    }

    protected void writeDone(final StreamSinkChannel channel) {
        try {
            channel.shutdownWrites();

            if (!channel.flush()) {
                channel.getWriteSetter().set(ChannelListeners.flushingChannelListener(new ChannelListener<StreamSinkChannel>() {
                    @Override
                    public void handleEvent(StreamSinkChannel o) {
                        IoUtils.safeClose(channel);
                    }
                }, ChannelListeners.closingChannelExceptionHandler()));
                channel.resumeWrites();

            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            handleError(channel, e);
        }
    }
}

    @Test
    void appliesConfiguredEntityLimitAndRecordsRequestStartTime() throws Exception {
        AtomicReference<HttpServerExchange> seen = new AtomicReference<>();
        OptionMap options = options(
                UndertowOptions.MAX_ENTITY_SIZE, 1234L,
                UndertowOptions.RECORD_REQUEST_START_TIME, true);
        TestHarness harness = new TestHarness("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.test\r\n\r\n",
                exchange -> seen.set(exchange), options);

        listener(harness).handleEvent(harness.sourceChannel());

        assertNotNull(seen.get());
        assertEquals(1234L, seen.get().getMaxEntitySize());
        assertTrue(seen.get().getRequestStartTime() > 0L);
    }

    @Test
    void derivesHttpsSchemeFromSslChannel() throws Exception {
        AtomicReference<HttpServerExchange> seen = new AtomicReference<>();
        SSLSession session = createNiceMock(SSLSession.class);
        replay(session);
        TestHarness harness = new TestHarness("GET /secure HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.test\r\n\r\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1),
                exchange -> seen.set(exchange), OptionMap.EMPTY, session);

        listener(harness).handleEvent(harness.sourceChannel());

        assertNotNull(seen.get());
        assertEquals("https", seen.get().getRequestScheme());
        assertTrue(harness.source.suspendCalls.get() >= 1);
    }

        WebSocket07Channel channel = newChannel(true, true, NoopExtensionFunction.INSTANCE);

        assertEquals(expectedType, sink.getClass());
        assertEquals(type, sink.getType());
        assertSame(channel, sink.getWebSocketChannel());
    }

            throws IOException {
        WebSocket07Channel.WebSocketFrameHeader frame = newFrame(channel);
        feed(frame, firstByte, 0);

        assertTrue(frame.isDone());
        assertTrue(frame.isFinalFragment());
        assertEquals(0, frame.getFrameLength());
        StreamSourceFrameChannel source = frame.getChannel(null);
        assertEquals(expectedChannelType, source.getClass());
        assertEquals(expectedFrameType, source.getType());
    }

    private void assertRejected(WebSocket07Channel channel, String expectedMessage, int... header) {
        WebSocket07Channel.WebSocketFrameHeader frame = newFrame(channel);
        WebSocketFrameCorruptedException exception = assertThrows(WebSocketFrameCorruptedException.class,
                () -> feed(frame, header));
        assertTrue(exception.getMessage().contains(expectedMessage),
                () -> "Expected message containing '" + expectedMessage + "' but was: "
                        + exception.getMessage());
        assertFalse(frame.isDone());
    }

        Set<WebSocketChannel> openConnections = new HashSet<>();
        return new TestWebSocket07Channel(connection, bufferPool, url, SUB_PROTOCOL, client,
                extensionsSupported, extensionFunction, openConnections, OptionMap.EMPTY);
    }

    private static WebSocket07Channel.WebSocketFrameHeader newFrame(WebSocket07Channel channel) {
        return (WebSocket07Channel.WebSocketFrameHeader) channel.receiveFrame();
    }

    private static void feed(WebSocket07Channel.WebSocketFrameHeader frame, int... values)
            throws WebSocketException {
        frame.handle(byteBuffer(values));
    }

    private static final class TestWebSocket07Channel extends WebSocket07Channel {
        private TestWebSocket07Channel(StreamConnection channel, ByteBufferPool bufferPool,

            super(channel, bufferPool, wsUrl, subProtocol, client, allowExtensions,
                    extensionFunction, openConnections, options);
        }

        boolean readsAreBroken() {
            return isReadsBroken();
        }
    }

    private static ByteBuffer byteBuffer(int... values) {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[values.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
            bytes[i] = (byte) values[i];
        }
        return ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes);

    void createInstanceWrapsEndpointOfMatchingType() throws Exception {

        AnnotatedEndpointFactory factory = create(TextEndpoint.class);

        IllegalArgumentException exception = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,

        assertTrue(exception.getMessage().contains("was not of correct type"), exception.getMessage());
        assertTrue(exception.getMessage().contains(TextEndpoint.class.getName()), exception.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    void createInstanceRejectsNullEndpointInstance() throws Exception {
        AnnotatedEndpointFactory factory = create(TextEndpoint.class);

        IllegalArgumentException exception = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> factory.createInstance(handle(null)));

        assertTrue(exception.getMessage().contains("was not of correct type"), exception.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    void createInstanceAcceptsSubclassOfTheEndpointClass() throws Exception {
        AnnotatedEndpointFactory factory = create(OpenBaseEndpoint.class);

        AnnotatedEndpoint endpoint = factory.createInstance(handle(new OpenOverrideEndpoint()));

        assertNotNull(endpoint);
    }
